title: IMP-0018 Phase 1: shared run-level prompt prefix, synthetic before/after
summary: Synthetic before/after comparison of shared run-level prompt prefix (IMP-0018 Phase 1) using deterministic offline harness, no network or model calls. Rendered every prompt of a synthetic orchestrator run (14 calls: 4 implementer, 2 test_author, 1 repairer, 6 reviewer, 1 planner) with the shared_prefix flag off and on, modelled provider prompt caching using longest common character prefix with earlier prompts, and measured via the context_economy harness. Before (flag=False): total 96,701 input tokens (79,064 cached, 17,637 uncached); worker input 89,617 tokens (79,064 cached, 10,553 uncached). After (flag=True): total 96,706 input tokens (82,997 cached, 13,709 uncached); worker input 89,622 tokens (82,997 cached, 6,625 uncached). Uncached reduction: 3,928 tokens (22.27% of total, 37.22% of worker input). Cache-read share increased from 0.8176 to 0.8582 overall, 0.8822 to 0.9261 for workers. Amplification pooled metrics unchanged (7.61 vs 7.61). Method: synthetic fixtures with deterministic modelled caching (floor(shared_chars/4) for prefix, per-call harness 6000 tokens), estimates labelled as estimates throughout. Default decision per shared-prefix.md (2026-10-02): False. Rationale: test_orchestrator_telemetry.EngineTelemetryTests.test_context_selection_is_recorded_for_registered_projects fails when flag is on (KeyError: candidate_tokens_estimate); a telemetry event schema update is required before enabling. Limits: EVR-0018's 99.05% fixed overhead share is an upper bound measured over duplicated per-worker input text, not a measured provider-side metric; it likely includes provider harness overhead (~6000 tokens/call, system prompt, tool schemas) that Phase 1 does not reduce. The fixture's 37.22% worker uncached reduction applies only to Orchestrator-written prompt text (~1% of total provider input per EVR-0018 amplification 104.8x), modelled on automatic token-granular prefix caching (OpenAI/Codex style) and is an upper bound for providers with coarser caching boundaries. Real-run re-measurement with `orchestrate context-economy` is still pending.

metrics.method: synthetic fixtures with deterministic provider-model prefix caching
